front.title: A YANG Data Model for Disaggregated Service Pipeline Timing and Bulk State-Mobility Telemetry

abstract.t: This document specifies a Standards Track YANG 1.1 data model (ietf- dcn-pipeline-state-telemetry) for monitoring multi-stage execution phase timing and bulk state-mobility telemetry in disaggregated data- center service pipelines. The model defines nine causally ordered lifecycle timestamps, interval-union de-duplication for overlapping pipeline stages, and three-tier byte accounting that separates mandatory transport-visible encoded-bytes from optional application- visible logical-bytes and metadata-bytes, enabling consistent multi- vendor operational diagnostics under the Network Management Datastore Architecture (NMDA).
